title: Refined Chisel
body:
Description

Refined Chisel is a third tier chisel, being sold on the shelf by the entrance of The Oak Depot for $5,000.

Chisels are tools used to slice refined and forged ores into pieces and shave rocks to fit into processors. Do note, that shaving will reduce yield of the ore/rock, so it's advised to save them to be processed in a bigger machine later.

Appearance

Refined Chisel, like the name implies, is a typical looking chisel made out of refined steel and wood. It's blade is made out of refined steel; using the default legacy metal material as it's coating. It's handle is made out of wood, painted blue; using the default legacy sand material as it's coating.

Trivia

  • Chisels are the only tools that do not have their stats listed in their descriptions, probably due to to the fact different tiers of chisels only vary in speed they can slice/shave an ore.
  • Refined Chisel was added significantly later than Refined Axe and Refined Pickaxe.
